books.title: Blessed Be Pain!
books.subtitle: Lessons on Sickness and Suffering from St. Josemaría Escrivá
books.author: Miguel Monge
books.blurb: For St Josemaría Escrivá, the founder of Opus Dei, suffering and sickness are sources of grace and strength for Christians and their work. His affirmation, “Blessed be pain” may surprise many, but it reveals his vision of the Cross—and by extension, all crosses—as the place where all sufferings may be united to those of Christ. In this way, all who suffer may become co-redeemers with Christ.

books.title: Look Up to Mary
books.subtitle: Imitating her Virtues in Ordinary Life
books.author: Antonio Orozco
books.blurb: Like looking directly at the sun, we get dazzled by the countenance of God. But we can look at Mary and see his refection in her. Thanks to Mary, we understand her Son better: perfect God and perfect man.

books.title: Human But Holy
books.subtitle: Getting to Know God, Yourself and Your Neighbor
books.blurb: Do I attach too much importance to money, to advancement, to social acceptance? Do I worry more about my children’s physical welfare than about their spiritual health? Am I more concerned about their scholastic success and material future than about their religious growth? Am I letting the pressures of my work and family duties infringe too much upon the duties I owe to God? The best of Catholics and the best of parents can be afflicted at times by doubts such as these. The answer is an old one: all that anyone can do is his best. As long as we try to make God our ultimate target, an occasional sway to left or to right will do no permanent damage. But let us test, from time to time, the strength of the ties which bind us to God and to man. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Yes, Father
books.subtitle: Uniformity with God’s Will
books.author: Richard Graef
books.blurb: This is a reprint of a spiritual classic which, as stated by the author, “is not an expression of a theory but a practical guide of souls”. Each chapter gives an explanation of a passage taken from Sacred Scripture which dwells on the central idea of surrendering one’s will to the will of God. It is aimed at increasing in the reader his love for and acceptance to the will of God, which is best expressed in developing human virtues as patience, suffering, examination of conscience and an incessant love for the Holy Mass, prayer, devotion to Our Lady, etc.

books.title: Lukewarmness
books.subtitle: The Devil In Disguise
books.author: Francis Carvajal
books.blurb: The condition of lukewarmness in the spiritual life is always preceded by a series of small infidelities. The radical cure to this sickness is thoroughly explained with practical resolutions.

books.title: Difficulties in Mental Prayer
books.author: Eugene Boylan
books.blurb: One cannot grow weary of praying. It has to be persevering, trusting, insistent and tireless, as this spiritual classic emphasizes.

books.title: Abandonment to Divine Providence
books.author: Jean-Pierre de Caussade
books.blurb: “A spiritual classic of the first order … a book for those who truly seek God,” It has a deserving place among the outstanding spiritual guides.

books.title: Christ on Earth
books.author: Joseph Pich
books.blurb: Christ lived on earth to show the example of how life is to be lived, to spiritualize what is otherwise nothing but gross matter. Through this book, one discovers the invisible God in the most visible things. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Introduction to Philosophy
books.author: Mariano Artigas
books.blurb: Discusses the principal issues concerning the nature, divisions and the role of Philosophy in Theology.

books.title: History of Ancient Philosophy
books.author: Ignatius Yarza
books.blurb: Shows the pitfalls, strengths and weaknesses of the arguments of early philosophers and their contribution to Christian philosophy.

books.title: Logic
books.author: Juan Jose Sanguineti
books.blurb: Logic is a means to know the truth. It is an invaluable tool to form the habit of orderly, precise and coherent thinking and reasoning.

books.title: Metaphysics
books.author: Tomas Alvira, et al
books.blurb: The science of being and ultimate cause, as it has always been understood from the time of Plato, Aristotle and St Thomas Aquinas, are presented in a clear manner.

books.title: Ethics in Medical Practice
books.subtitle: Summary, Explanation & Defense of Concrete Ethical Problems
books.author: Michael Monge, M.D.
books.blurb: This updated book presents a number of areas of current debate in medicine. It tackles general questions of the nature of moral action and decision-making in healthcare practice: the right to life, abortion, euthanasia, therapeutic abortion, organ transplants, in vitro fertilization, contraception, human experiments. The author writes briefly on the patient’s right to a dignified humane treatment and spiritual care, his right to privacy as safeguarded by professional secrecy, medical secrets and the computer.

books.title: Marriage, a Path to Sanctity
books.author: Javier Abad and Eugenio Fenoy
books.blurb: Marriage should be seen as a path to heroic virtue, a generous exercise of the love of God. It demands self-sacrificing love, which is necessary for personal sanctification. A complete guidebook for married couples.

books.title: Training and Forming Children
books.subtitle: 2nd Edition
books.author: Javier Abad and Eugenio Fenoy
books.blurb: Here is a clear and practical guide to educate your child in Freedom & Responsibility, Motivation, Intellectual Development, Choosing A Career, Social Adjustment, Education in Sexuality. Because your child is first and foremost a person who can think and decide for himself. And only you can make sure that he does this well.

books.title: Sexuality and Sanctity
books.author: Joseph de Torre
books.blurb: Everyone has to be well informed about the very timely and controversial issue on sex. The author discusses how it should neither be despised on account of its materiality – nor glorified above its real value. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: The Saints & the Blessed of the 21st Century
books.blurb: Timelines of A. del Portillo, John XXIII, John Paul II, Padre Pio, Mother Teresa & J. Escrivá

books.title: The Story of a Family
books.subtitle: The Home of St Therese, the Little Flower
books.author: Fr. Stephane-Joseph Piat
books.blurb: This book gives a vivid portrayal of a Christian marriage. Living in this time and age when so many unhealthy influences have attacked the indissolubility of marriage and the unity of the home, what an attractive and persuasive sight was the household of Louis and Zelie Martin!

books.title: Simon Peter
books.author: George Chevrot
books.blurb: Peter had almost the same weaknesses as ours. In this book, we discover how he solved his problems, inspiring us with the great desire to imitate his virtues.

books.title: The Bones of St. Peter
books.author: John Evangelist Walsh
books.blurb: The fascinating account of the search for the body of the first pope of all Christendom is like reading an Agatha Christie thriller, as clue after clue is found and solved… Profusely illustrated and highly readable.

books.title: The Story of a Soul
books.subtitle: The Autobiography of St. Therese of Lisieux
books.blurb: Translated by John Beevers Her way of spiritual childhood is to serve God, not for the sake of a reward, but solely out of love and a desire to win souls for God.

books.title: The Virtues of 50 Saints
books.subtitle: What made them holy?
books.blurb: Text by Carlos Pujol Illustrated by Albert Gamos A book to guide you to the wisdom and wonder of Christian heroes. Get a glimpse of their inspiring lives and let it guide your own. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Handbook of Prayers
books.subtitle: Regular Php 475.00
books.blurb: A complete treasury of prayers and Order of Mass in Latin and English (2012 English translation). Available in two sizes: Pocket 3.625″ x 5.625″ and Regular 4.5″ x 7″.

books.title: Magdasal Tayo
books.subtitle: Mga Dasal Pang Araw-Araw

books.title: What is the Holy Mass? / Ano Ang Banal Na Misa?
books.blurb: A better understanding of the Mass will make us pray with more devotion. Being more aware of what is happening at the altar, one will reap more benefits from this storehouse of blessings and graces if one attends with the proper dispositions. What we get out of the Holy Mass cannot be acquired by any other means. One cannot acquire it with the reception of the other sacraments nor by prayer or sacrifices alone. The Mass has an infinite value. It gives more glory to God than all the penances, tears and prayers of all the holy souls combined.

books.title: How to Receive Holy Communion Well
books.author: Francisco Luna

books.title: How to Help Children in Their Studies
books.author: Gerardo Castillo
books.blurb: Parents are the first educators of their children.

books.title: St. Catherine of Siena
books.author: Joachim Esteban
books.blurb: The wonderful story of a dynamic saint for today. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Guidebook for Confession for Children
books.author: Beatriz B. Brilliantes
books.blurb: This guidebook was prepared for children to learn how to pray and how to deal with Jesus in a way suitable to their age. The illustrations and explanations facilitate the proper reception of the Sacrament of Confession. It is simple in approach and easy reading for a child. Parents have to encourage their children to make a good examination of conscience before going to Confession. It is necessary to remove their fear and anxiety to receive the sacrament worthily. In this guidebook, the child will understand the meaning of sin and its consequences, what makes a good confession, what to remember when they go to the priest, the meaning of atonement and how to do the penance which the priest gives them.

books.title: My First Confession
books.subtitle: My First Communion
books.author: Pedro dela Herran and Adolfo Petit
books.blurb: Teaching the Catechism to children should be, but frequently is not, the most interesting task of all parents and catechists. One important cause of the lack of enthusiasm is the fact that the books are not designed nor organized according to the level of the children. Usually the lesson is limited to the repetition of formulas which, even if well memorized, are rather too often but barely understood. My First Confession, My First Communion is a guidebook which covers all the salient points of the Catholic faith. Each of the 29 lessons include 1) a short narrative, 2) a biblical reference, 3) a practical resolution, 4) a question and answer catechism, and 5) exercises to check the child’s retention of each topic. It also has a Homework to impress the matter more firmly in the minds of the young. This book is the product of years of teaching experience and has yielded positive results. It has been proven to be an important tool in enticing the child into discovering the wealth of the Catholic faith if it is taught properly.

books.title: Children’s Bible
books.author: Juan Suriñach
books.blurb: Provides lessons and resolutions with colored illustrations based on sound and complete doctrine from the Creation of Man to the Coronation of the Blessed Virgin.

books.title: Alexia
books.subtitle: A Story of Joy and Heroism in Suffering
books.author: Michael A. Monge
books.blurb: The moving story of a 14-year old girl who died of Ewing’s Sarcoma gives lessons on peaceful optimism and serene acceptance of pain. Read on and pray… and it’s alright to shed a tear or two. A story of a great soul housed in a body of pain.

books.title: Yes!
books.subtitle: The Life of Josemaría Escrivá for Young Readers
books.author: Michael Carceles and Elizabeth Torra
books.blurb: For children and also adults, this well-illustrated book focuses on the important milestones in the life of Saint Josemaría Escrivá, considered one of the prominent figures in the Church of this century. Large format. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: The Way
books.blurb: Saint Escrivá’s first and best known work with sales of more than 3 million copies. 999 brief points for prayer and meditation. Also in Tagalog, Chinese and Bahasa Indonesia.

books.title: Furrow
books.blurb: 1,000 points made up of passengers from Sacred Scripture, personal experiences and passages from letters of Saint Escrivá.

books.title: The Forge
books.blurb: 1,055 points which leads the reader to the forge of divine love and enkindles within it a desire for holiness and apostolate.

books.title: Holy Rosary
books.blurb: The 15 mysteries vividly portrayed to help us become absorbed in contemplation when we pray to our Lady.

books.title: Christ is Passing by
books.blurb: The first published collection of homilies given by Saint Escrivá. Each one is imprinted with the great love he had for God and men.

books.title: Friends of God
books.blurb: This collection of 18 homilies touches on the theme of Christian virtues, life of piety and dealings with God and the Blessed Virgin.

books.title: The Way • Furrow • the Forge
books.subtitle: For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com
books.blurb: The three best-known works of Saint Escrivá now combined in one volume with an expanded index. A very useful and handy edition for everyone to have.

books.title: The New Testament
books.subtitle: (Confraternity Edition)
books.blurb: A revision of the Challoner-Rheims Version translated from the Latin Vulgate. Pocket size with vinyl cover and ribbon-marker.

books.title: The Faith Explained
books.author: Leo J. Trese
books.blurb: Central elements of the Catholic faith – the Creed, prayer and the commandments – in a clear and vivid writing style.

books.title: Question & Answer
books.subtitle: Catholic Catechism
books.author: Fr. Marciano Guzman
books.blurb: This book will serve as a useful instrument for teachers and students of religion and for those looking for a reliable guide in the study of the Catholic faith. For many years, this handy pocket-size edition has filled the need for a simplified assimilation of doctrine by the ordinary faithful and enables them to commit to memory many brief formulations of the faith. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Journey to the Depths of Hope
books.author: Jose Luis Olaizola
books.blurb: A famous writer tracks Opus Dei’s activities in Latin America, the ‘continent of hope,’ and meets people who received extraordinary favors from Saint Escrivá. The colorful anecdotes confirm the universality of Opus Dei.

books.title: You Are the Light of the World
books.subtitle: Explaining Opus Dei to the Youth
books.author: Martin Rhonheimer
books.blurb: “You are the light of the world.” Jesus said this to his disciples and to all Christians. This book says how one can love and follow Jesus Christ in the ordinary life. It is addressed in a particular way to the youth, to whom the Founder of Opus Dei, St Josemaría Escrivá, said many times: Through the world still echoes that divine cry: “I have come to cast fire upon the earth, and what will I but that it be kindled?” And you see: it has nearly all died out… “Don’t you want to spread the blaze?” For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: Ethics
books.subtitle: A Modern Version of Its Classic Themes
books.author: Leonardo Polo
books.blurb: Leonardo Polo’s Ethics is not a manual or textbook, but an attempt to study ethics in statu nascente, as it arises in human experience. It is Polo’s intention to demonstrate that “no dimension of human action is indifferent to ethics,” that ethics is not something accidental or adventitious, one more among several competing systems of laws of human behavior, but rather something intrinsic to all human action – from its inception in the human mind through its execution to the consequences that follow long after it has been completed. For inquiries/orders, email us at: sinagtal@gmail.com

books.title: My Angel Will Go Before You
books.author: George Huber
books.blurb: A book about our Guardian Angels, our heavenly messengers and protectors, who provide strength and confidence 24 hours a day.

books.title: God and Children
books.author: Jesus Urteaga
books.blurb: A welcome change from the usual excessively psychological books on the subject. A book with deep, commonsensical spirituality.

books.title: Letters to Mankind
books.author: Jesus Urteaga
books.blurb: The author compiles his letters addressed to all men, God’s creatures, children of God. He gives counsel, food for thought and surprisingly, learns himself as he looks into their lives.

books.title: The Way of the Cross
books.blurb: A handy book for the popular practice of the Via Crucis with points for meditation after each station.
